name: Lanternbearer (Example)
author: voodoo573
description: EXAMPLE ITEM. A fighter archetype for warriors who carry a blessed lantern into dark places, keeping their friends safe and pushing back the shadows.
summary: Example fighter subclass: a lantern-carrying guardian of the party.

data.name: Lanternbearer (Example)
data.desc: A fighter who carries a blessed lantern into the dark and keeps companions safe.

3.name: Guiding Lantern
3.desc: Your lantern sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for a further 20 feet. Allies in the bright light can't be surprised while you are conscious.

3.name: Steady Light
3.desc: As a bonus action, you can grant one ally in your lantern's bright light advantage on their next saving throw before the start of your next turn. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.

7.name: Beacon
7.desc: Your lantern's bright light radius increases to 30 feet, and you gain proficiency in Perception.

10.name: Warding Glow
10.desc: You and allies in your lantern's bright light have resistance to necrotic damage.

15.name: Shadowbane
15.desc: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage.

18.name: Undying Flame
18.desc: When you drop to 0 hit points but aren't killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead and your lantern flares: each ally in its bright light regains 2d8 hit points. Once used, you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
